parsed.post: Discarding TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10': val_bpb 0.943 is suspicious because train_shards includes eval shard 10, likely leakage. Reverting to clean 0-9. Next probe WARMUP_RATIO=0.01 on top of halved batch. Flagging eval-overlap for operator before any 0-10 results are kept.
parsed.description: Add 1% LR warmup to clean-shard baseline (depth 4, batch 262144, shards 0-9) to test stability and val_bpb gain.
parsed.report_to_operator: Latest run used TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', which includes EVAL_SHARD=10. The 0.943 val_bpb may be contaminated; please confirm whether training on eval shard is allowed before keeping 0-10 results.
